written.myAnswer: Medicine and surgery diagnose and treat diseases in people and may involve operations to repair, replace or remove defective body parts. Animal husbandry involves breeding and caring for livestock to improve their quality and productivity.

Studying Biology can lead to further professional studies in fields such as medicine and surgery, dentistry, pharmacology, physiotherapy, fisheries and wildlife, agriculture, animal husbandry, horticulture, forestry, biotechnology and forensics. These fields apply biological knowledge in different careers and require their own relevant degrees or courses.
